name: bloom-lockup
title: Bloom Lockup
description: Logo reveal in four seconds. A wall of finished work blooms outward from your logo, cuts in tight on it, then bends away through a lens and a flash while the logo rises to take its wordmark and tagline. Measured frame by frame off a reference recording.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/bloom-lockup?ref=cli — 120 frames at 30fps; paints its own background. Pass your logo as SVG paths (logo={{ width, height, shapes }}) and your screens as images. — 82 Pro components too — charts, launch scenes, device shots: https://snapcn.dev/docs/pricing?ref=cli-docs
